description: Daily snow depth, snow water equivalent, precipitation accumulation and temperatures for the last 1–30 days at the resort's station (SNOTEL where there is one, Open-Meteo model otherwise), newest first. Use it for "how has the base changed this week" questions. Pass `season` (`2024-25`, or `current`) for a whole season's daily depth and new-snow rows instead of the last N days; get_season_stats summarises a season.

days.description: Days back, 1–30. Ignored when `season` is set.

season.description: A season label (`2024-25` for the Northern water year, `2026` for an Andes resort) or `current`: returns every daily row of that season, oldest first, with daily new snow.

slug.description: PeakCam resort slug, lowercase kebab-case, e.g. `breckenridge` or `ski-portillo`. Get it from search_resorts.

name: get_snow_history

generatedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC instant the result was generated.

newSnowIn.description: Daily new snow (positive depth change), season reads only.

season.description: The season label when `season` was asked for; null for a last-N-days read.

elevationFt.description: Station elevation in feet. Measurements describe this elevation, not the resort's summit.

title: Snow history
